intro.heading: An Exceptional Culinary Journey at Sea
paragraphs: Dining is one of the definitive highlights of any luxury cruise, and Scenic delivers an exceptional culinary experience that rivals many of the world's finest luxury hotels and Michelin-starred establishments.

Whether sailing aboard Scenic Eclipse or Scenic Eclipse II, guests enjoy an extraordinary variety of dining venues, fresh artisanal ingredients, attentive white-glove service, and beautifully presented cuisine inspired by global destinations.

Unlike many cruise lines that rely heavily on buffet dining, Scenic emphasizes made-to-order meals, up to 10 distinct specialty restaurants, premium ingredients, and personalized service. Combined with an extensive selection of complimentary premium wines, Champagnes, craft cocktails, and specialty coffees, dining becomes an unforgettable part of the expedition.

items.desc: The main restaurant serving breakfast, lunch, and dinner with international menus, fresh Italian pastas, steakhouse cuts, and destination-inspired cuisine.

expertInsight.title: Expert Insight from Angela Hughes
expertInsight.name: Angela Hughes
expertInsight.quote: According to Angela Hughes, many travelers are initially drawn to Scenic by its discovery yachts — but ultimately fall in love with the all-inclusive onboard culinary experience. Having up to 10 distinct dining venues on a 228-passenger ship provides a level of variety and intimacy that few cruise lines can match.
priorities: Butler service for every suite tier
Lumière French fine dining & Champagne bar
expertInsight.bio: Angela Hughes is a globally recognized luxury travel advisor with over 40 years of experience, having traveled to 121+ countries. She specializes in ultra-luxury yachting, luxury cruise dining, butler services, and custom bespoke itineraries.

faqs.question: Is the food good on Scenic Cruises?
faqs.answer: Yes. Scenic is widely recognized for offering exceptional cuisine with fresh ingredients, multiple restaurants, and destination-inspired menus that rival top luxury hotels.

faqs.question: Are specialty restaurants included on Scenic?
faqs.answer: Yes. Most specialty restaurants aboard Scenic Eclipse—including Lumière, Koko's Asian Fusion, Elements, and Azure Bar & Café—are completely included in your cruise fare.

faqs.question: Does Scenic offer room service?
faqs.answer: Yes. Guests can enjoy comprehensive 24-hour in-suite dining and personalized room service served by their butler throughout their voyage.

faqs.question: Are premium beverages included?
faqs.answer: Yes. Premium wines, French Champagne, top-shelf spirits, craft cocktails, craft beers, and barista specialty coffees are all included with no hidden charges.

faqs.question: Does Scenic accommodate dietary restrictions?
faqs.answer: Yes. Scenic offers extensive vegetarian, vegan, gluten-free, dairy-free, low-sodium, and allergy-friendly dining options across all restaurants.

faqs.question: Is there a buffet on Scenic?
faqs.answer: Scenic focuses primarily on made-to-order dishes and intimate fine dining restaurants rather than traditional large buffet lines, ensuring maximum freshness.

faqs.question: Which restaurant is most popular aboard Scenic Eclipse?
faqs.answer: Lumière (contemporary French fine dining) and Koko's Asian Fusion (featuring sushi and teppanyaki) are among the most celebrated dining venues aboard.

faqs.question: Are restaurant reservations required?
faqs.answer: While venues like Elements and Azure require no reservations, intimate experiences such as Chef's Table and Night Market require advance reservations due to limited seating.

faqs.question: Is the dining experience formal?
faqs.answer: The atmosphere is stylish and elegant yet relaxed. There are no mandatory black-tie or tuxedo nights, allowing guests to dine comfortably in elegant smart-casual attire.

faqs.question: Does Scenic serve regional cuisine?
faqs.answer: Yes. Executive chefs frequently incorporate regional specialties, local market provisions, and indigenous culinary traditions inspired by the destinations visited.

faqs.question: Is Scenic better than other luxury cruise lines for food?
faqs.answer: Many travelers and critics rate Scenic among the best in luxury cruising due to its remarkable variety (10 venues for 228 guests), complimentary fine beverages, and lack of specialty dining surcharges.

faqs.question: Is Scenic worth it for food lovers?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. Scenic delivers one of the finest culinary programs at sea, making it an outstanding investment for travelers who value exceptional gastronomy and seamless luxury.
